title: Account Issues
text: Pretty good except I paid for Pro and now apparently it is a monthly subscription and I have to deal with ads etc. all over again unless I now pay each month. Seems like a bait and switch.  Not worth a monthly fee.

title: Can’t change the rows
text: It’s faded out and cannot change

title: Super
text: My first time of using this app and it’s very helpful I recommend everyone who wants to learn how to draw to download it.

title: Grid is easy but...
text: Just got this and it was easy to add a grid.                    BUT the ads are a real pain, really!!!    And there was no way to stop them.                                                                            I'd rather pay a few dollars and not have the ads.

title: New user
text: Just got this app.  Some instructions would be very helpful. I’m NOT tech savvy.

title: Mostly decent but bottom crop handle on an iPhone SE
text: My subject line tells it all. Not every artist has a new iPhone. It’s disappointing that you can’t engage the bottom crop handle on an iPhone SE.

title: Not clear = not useful
text: Not clear : no definition of terms; no explanation of use.

title: Awful app.
text: Very limited functionality. Cannot specify number of lines or columns.  I deleted it once I tried it out.  Good thing it’s free. Not worth paying for.

title: It won’t upload photos
text: I really thought this was going to be awesome. That said it only uploads ‘some’ photos when it wants to. I’ve allowed access to all photos  on my library, I re-downloaded the app, still will not allow some photos to upload. I read through the reviews and noted a few others had same issue. The developers response was clear as mud.

title: so-so
text: Can’t find rulers so the app doesn’t save much time at all from traditional methods.

title: Worst app ever
text: There is not even a control where you can select the size of your paper and that is mainly why I downloaded this app. Don’t download this app it’s a waste of time. I would have given a 0 star rating but that isn’t a option. This app is terrible!!!

title: No photos
text: Downloaded this tonight. It will not load any of my photos. I checked my settings, and it says that the app is allowed access to all of my photos. I tried restarting my iPad, but that didn’t help.

title: You Can’t Do ANYTHING Other Than Load an Image
text: There areNO drawing tools whatsoever.  All you can do is load an image with the grid.  It doesn’t even respond to the Apple Pencil.
